package.author: 10bit FX Limited
package.description: Free plugin that adds NotchLC import and export support to Windows AVI applications and legacy QuickTime 7.

en-US.author: 10bit FX Limited
en-US.description: Free plugin that adds NotchLC import and export support to Windows AVI applications and legacy QuickTime 7.
en-US.longDescription: The NotchLC Plugin for AVI & Legacy QuickTime adds NotchLC support to Windows AVI containers through a DirectShow filter and to legacy QuickTime 7 for Windows. It is provided free of charge and does not require a Notch Builder or Playback license. To use NotchLC in QuickTime, legacy QuickTime 7 must be installed before this plugin.
en-US.name: NotchLC Plugin for AVI & Legacy QuickTime
